catalog.name: Reddit
catalog.description: Read, comment, post, vote and join subreddits — the agent acts as you in a real logged-in browser.
catalog.hint: Use Log in to sign in once — the agent then acts as you on Reddit. Automating an account may be against Reddit's terms — use your own.

catalog.name: X (Twitter)
catalog.description: Read, reply, post, like, follow and join Communities — the agent acts as you in a real logged-in browser.
catalog.hint: Use Log in to sign in once — the agent then acts as you on X. Automating an account may be against X's terms — use your own.

catalog.name: YouTube
catalog.description: Watch, comment, reply, like and subscribe (join channels) — the agent acts as you in a real logged-in browser.
catalog.hint: Use Log in to sign in once — the agent then acts as you on YouTube. Google is strict about automated logins — completing sign-in yourself in the window is what gets past that.
